mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT t1.permission FROM sys_menu AS t1 INNER JOIN eve_effective_role_menu AS t2 ON t2.menu_id = t1.id INNER JOIN sys_role AS t3 ON t3.id = t2.role_id AND t3.tenant_id = t2.tenant_id INNER JOIN sys_user_role AS t4 ON t4.role_id = t3.id AND t4.tenant_id = t3.tenant_id INNER JOIN sys_user AS t5 ON t5.id = t4.user_id AND t5.tenant_id = t3.tenant_id WHERE t1.deleted = 0 AND t5.id = #{userId} AND t1.status = 1 AND t1.permission IS NOT NULL

SELECT t1.* FROM sys_menu AS t1 INNER JOIN eve_effective_role_menu AS t2 ON t2.menu_id = t1.id INNER JOIN sys_role AS t3 ON t3.id = t2.role_id AND t3.tenant_id = t2.tenant_id WHERE t1.deleted = 0 AND t3.id = #{roleId} AND t1.status = 1
